notes: "Select the title and open Properties. Edit Text content for that object, and use the font and alignment controls when the change requires them. Check the canvas at presentation scale before clicking Save slides in the top bar. A saved-operation record can then be inspected in History. The capture shows the actual selected title and Properties fields; this page does not pretend that a new edit has already happened."

designIntent.purpose: Teach selected text editing, canvas inspection and an explicit save.
keep: Keep actual interface pixels, source attribution and the demonstrated behavior.
Keep stable page identity, editable objects and the correct author watermark.
designIntent.requestedChange: Teach an actionable Editor workflow through clear pictures and a focused narrative.
